Ch 466 § 466-1 EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTION, DISPLAY FIREWORKS MANUAL

response.text: Consumer fireworks may be discharged in the City only on Victoria Day, Canada Day, or a day covered by a special occasions fireworks discharge permit issued by the Fire Chief [2]. If weather such as rain, fog, smog or wind makes it impractical or unsafe, the next day before or after Victoria Day or Canada Day becomes the designated day [2]. On Victoria Day or Canada Day (or their weather substitutes), no discharge is allowed after 11:00 p.m. [2]. Other days require a special occasions permit, which is for religious, cultural and special events and carries a fee [3][7]. Even on permitted days, you must do it on your own land (or private land with the owner's prior written consent), not in a building, vehicle or public place, and not within 100 metres of where explosives, gasoline or other highly flammable substances are sold or stored [2]. You must also keep a fire extinguisher, 10-litre water unit or charged garden hose ready on site [2]. Minors (under 18) may not discharge fireworks [1][6].
